The contract pins a spec revision and was authored 2026-08-19, before the 2026-08-21 amendment (commit 9997091c) that rewrote AC-010 from a four-target to a five-target payload set in the acceptance-tests.md included in this bundle. findings.ref: bundle section list (no section for the staged human-copy check-risk-upgrade.sh/.ps1 or risk-upgrade-policy.md); reports/implementation/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/T-002.md ("Outputs" table; "Security review: not yet independently recorded")
findings.note: The task's three primary deliverables are absent from the bundle and carry no SHA-256 in the Outputs table, which lists only the eight test files, green.log, tasks.md and CHANGELOG.md. This is a risk:high, Security-Sensitive:true script that parses externally supplied JSON and decides full-required vs lite-eligible, and the implementation report itself records that its staged content has never had a dedicated security review. Its parsing, quoting and fail-closed logic cannot be read or hash-verified from this bundle, so no credit can be given for it beyond the behavioural assertions the four suites happen to make.

The required placeholder-scan check is recorded "passes": true while its own evidence records exit 1 with 5 findings on CHANGELOG.md, a file T-002 declares as one of its own Outputs and edited this session. The scanner's own message requires each finding to be fixed "or explicitly accepted by a human in the quality-gate report"; no such human acceptance appears anywhere in this bundle, so the pass rests on a scope narrowed to exclude a file the task changed.

findings.ref: design.md (API / Contract Plan, REQ-002 processing step 2b) and the fail-closed suite (TEST-013a..f)
findings.note: The fail-closed validation list covers only unreadable / not-valid-JSON / missing "capabilities" / "capabilities" not an array / entry missing "id" or "eligible". Neither the design nor TEST-013 covers a present-but-wrong-typed field: an entry whose "eligible" is the string "false" rather than the boolean, or whose "upgrade_reasons" is a string rather than an array. On an access-control-like gate whose purpose is to stop a Lite-ineligible Capability, a truthy string evaluated loosely in bash or PowerShell would make an ineligible entry contribute nothing and exit 0 -- the exact silent-degrade Blockers [B3]/[B4] were written to prevent. Untested in both runtimes.

The Done-When TDD bullet requires RED for each listed item, but the red log contains no capture for TEST-007 (item 4, byte-identical legacy path); only items 5, 13 and 14 appear. Under the "point SUT at the live script" mechanism this red log used, a TEST-007 red is structurally unobtainable (live vs live is trivially identical), but the log does not say so, leaving an unexplained hole in the RED evidence.

AC-009's no-DSL/no-Registry-call assertion is a grep for three literal name fragments. The red log shows TEST-009a/b/c passing identically against the live, unextended script, so the check has no discriminating power over the extension: any differently named helper call would satisfy it.

Unlike the other shared logs, this one carries no run timestamp, cwd or branch line, and it reports "WARNING: evidence bundle for task T-004 was generated with a dirty working tree". The contract's claim that this check was re-run rather than re-typed cannot be corroborated from the log's own content.
